source: Internet Archive djen-tjro-2025 OCR cadernos (public DJEN publications) for the original 20-doc seed; TJRO JURIS system (src/tjro_juris, real digitally-native court text, not OCR) for the 20-doc expansion batch, the 20-doc preliminar-targeted Round A batch, the 20-doc costs/fees-targeted Round B batch, the 18-doc general-volume Round C batch, and the 8-doc honorarios_fim-targeted Round D batch
per_class_note: Counts above are train-split only, matching the original convention. Round D closed the last G2 gap: honorarios_fim went from 6 to 12 in train (>=10 minimum). Candidates were pre-filtered on 'homologacao'/'acordo' co-occurring with 'honorarios' but NOT the fused 'custas e/ou honorarios' phrasing that Round B/C found dominant -- 7 of 8 candidates confirmed a genuinely separate honorarios clause with its own natural closing (the filter's one false positive was a document where 'honorarios' only appeared in case-classification metadata, not an operative clause, and was correctly left untagged rather than forced). ALL G1 and G2 gates are now clear across every split. Only G4 (waived) and G5 (volume) remain open.
labeler: prompt_subagents:haiku (original 20-doc seed, one labeling subagent per batch, acordaos first); prompt_subagents:general-purpose, one per document, for the 20-doc JURIS expansion batch, the 20-doc Round A preliminar-targeted batch, the 20-doc Round B costs/fees-targeted batch, the 18-doc Round C general-volume batch, and the 8-doc Round D honorarios_fim-targeted batch
verification_note: IMPORTANT provenance distinction: the original 20-doc seed's val+test went through a decorrelated 4-role Sonnet ensemble verification pass before being trusted as eval-quality gold. The 20-doc JURIS expansion batch, the 20-doc Round A preliminar-targeted batch (tjro_juris_acordao_prelim_*), the 20-doc Round B costs/fees-targeted batch (tjro_juris_sentenca_costs_*), the 18-doc Round C general-volume batch (tjro_juris_sentenca_vol_*), and the 8-doc Round D batch (tjro_juris_sentenca_hon_*) have NOT gone through that ensemble verification -- each has single-subagent labeling (one general-purpose agent per document, each independently briefed with the full annotation guideline), mechanical validation (opf_annotate.py validate: 0 offset/overlap/label-space errors across all splits), and a manual spot-check of a sample of records by the orchestrating session (not exhaustive, not the full ensemble). Treat val/test docs from these batches as provisional-quality until they receive the same ensemble verification pass the original seed used, especially before reporting any eval metric that includes them.
notes: Seed gold built the subagent way: strict sampling (acordao requires ACORDAO+VOTO+ACORDAM, sentenca requires SENTENCA+dispositivo-formula+operative-verb; despachos excluded), Haiku labeling subagents returning {category,match,nth}, offsets resolved by opf_annotate from-spans, overlaps removed deterministically, then a decorrelated 4-role Sonnet ensemble over val+test. ref_normativa was originally excluded (regex pre-pass at inference) but was added back to the trained label space and bootstrapped into every split via the same regex pre-pass (scripts/ref_normativa_prepass.py) against the already-verified gold text -- see git history for the architecture decision and the regex fix (thousands-separator article numbers, spelled-out inciso/paragrafo/alinea) that preceded it. A second real bug was found and fixed in scripts/ref_normativa_prepass.py's merge_with_opf_spans: it only reliably favored a gold/model span over an overlapping regex span on an exact start-position tie, not on the more common case of a regex match starting earlier but still partially overlapping -- a real gold custas_fim span was being silently dropped by this before the fix. 20-doc JURIS expansion batch added 2026-07-16 (see verification_note above) via the same subagent-labeling + opf_annotate.py from-spans/validate pipeline as the original seed, sourced from src/tjro_juris rather than DJEN cadernos. A follow-up 20-doc Round A batch (also 2026-07-16) closed the preliminar_inicio/fim zero-support gap: candidates were pre-filtered from TJRO JURIS's 2024-08-ACORDAO.parquet for a literal '\\b1\\.\\s*PRELIMINARES?\\b' numbered-heading match (found via manual audit that this heading convention is real but recent -- zero hits in 2005/2008/2017 samples, 21 hits in 2024-08 alone), then subagent-labeled the same way; all 20 confirmed a genuine preliminar section, split 14/3/3 train/val/test (seed 771). A follow-up 20-doc Round B batch (also 2026-07-16) targeted custas_fim/honorarios_fim/fundamentacao_legal: candidates were pre-filtered from TJRO JURIS's 2022-02-SENTENCA.parquet for both 'custas' and 'honorarios' substring mentions (excluding the 10 sentenca ids already used in the earlier expansion batch); several subagents independently anchored custas and honorarios on the exact same fused-clause span (a genuine ambiguity in Juizado Especial boilerplate, not an agent error -- the guideline explicitly allowed it), which opf_annotate validate correctly rejected as BIOES overlaps; 13 such conflicts were resolved deterministically by keeping the first-listed span and dropping the duplicate, then the batch was split 14/3/3 with a hand-picked (not random) val/test doc selection to guarantee each weak category met its per-split minimum despite the tiny (5-20 doc) supply for some categories. An 18-doc Round C batch (also 2026-07-16) pulled a fresh, unfiltered SENTENCA sample from TJRO JURIS's 2020-10-SENTENCA.parquet (a file not used by any prior batch) purely for G5 volume, split 12/3/3 (random, seed 773) -- it produced zero new honorarios_fim, a real finding about how rare that specific closing shape is, not a labeling gap; that finding directly informed Round D's pre-filter design (also 2026-07-16), which specifically excluded the fused 'custas e/ou honorarios' phrasing and targeted homologacao-de-acordo sentencas instead, yielding 7/8 clean honorarios_fim hits and closing the last G2 gap (see per_class_note). Single-tribunal (TJRO) corpus of 106 docs; only G5 volume (needs >=150 total, currently 106) and the waived G4 multi-tribunal gate remain before this gold clears every readiness gate for a real (non --smoke) training run.
